catalogue.definition: Employees (permanent, fixed-term, working students) employed on the last day of the month, including people on leave. Contractors are not employees.
catalogue.name: Headcount

catalogue.definition: Sum of contracted FTE of the headcount.
catalogue.name: Full-time equivalents

catalogue.definition: Employees whose first day falls in the month, rehires included.
catalogue.name: Hires

catalogue.definition: Voluntary leavers (last day in the window) over the average month-end headcount in the window.
catalogue.name: Voluntary turnover, trailing 12 months

catalogue.definition: Employees whose last day falls in the month and who left within 90 days of their first day.
catalogue.name: New starters gone within 90 days

catalogue.definition: Share of the headcount whose base salary is below 0.9 of their level's band midpoint for their country.
catalogue.name: Paid below 90 percent of band

catalogue.definition: Requisitions open on the last day of the month.
catalogue.name: Open requisitions

catalogue.definition: Median days from opening to filling, over requisitions filled in the trailing 3 months.
catalogue.name: Median days to fill

before_after.label: Pilot read out before/after instead of randomised

model_alone.label: Same data, AI without guardrails (no sensitive-topic rule, no checks)

naive_forecast.label: Trailing averages instead of the forecasts

no_identity.label: No identity linking across the two HRIS

small_groups_only.label: Hide small groups, but not their siblings

status_quo.label: Spreadsheets: an export from each system, an analyst's definitions, every cell shared

gates.gate: Published KPI cells that match the truth
Cells about fewer than 5 people revealed, directly or by subtraction
Seeds where the pilot's interval covers the true time saved
Sensitive questions read by the model
Assistant wrong-answer rate minus the People team's
Exit comments coded to the real reason
